verdict.rationale: Bolt.new is itself an AI coding agent: it offers Standard and Max agents and gives AI models control of the dev environment. That makes it an MCP client, not a product that serves tools to other agents. The MCP evidence (the GitHub MCP connector and the connect-mcp docs) is client-side and does not count toward this server axis. Nothing in the pack shows Bolt exposing its own MCP server or hosted MCP endpoint.
